_comment: Published checkpoint -> the modelopt_recipes recipe that reproduces it. Scope is NVIDIA's own releases; partner-published checkpoints in the collection are listed under 'unmapped'. Coverage is deliberately partial while the backfill lands in batches, one source-model org per branch -- run verify_recipes.py to see which checkpoints are not covered yet. Verified against published_checkpoints.json.
_source_model_comment: source_model: the checkpoint's source weights, used to key its alias folder under modelopt_recipes/models/. Only needed when the release's model card carries no base_model field; otherwise it is read from published_checkpoints.json.

nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Super-120B-A12B.approximate: AutoQuant per-layer map; the recipe's own header says it approximately mirrors the release. Residual: a few Mamba in/out_proj and latent-proj layers differ, and the release's KV cache used a constant amax (k_scale == 1.0) while the recipe calibrates it.

nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Ultra-550B-A55B.approximate: AutoQuant per-layer map; the recipe's own header says it approximately mirrors the release. Residual: a few Mamba in/out_proj and latent-proj layers differ, and the release's KV cache used a constant amax (k_scale == 1.0) while the recipe calibrates it.

unmapped.black-forest-labs/FLUX.1-dev-onnx: published by black-forest-labs, not NVIDIA. It is also an ONNX export, not a ModelOpt HF checkpoint
unmapped.nvidia/Kimi-K3-NVFP4-MXFP8-BACKUP-202608: dated backup snapshot of the Kimi-K3 release; its attention projections are BF16 rather than the block-FP8 of the current nvidia/Kimi-K3-NVFP4
unmapped.thinkingmachines/Inkling-NVFP4: published by thinkingmachines, not NVIDIA. It is also a third-party export: fused expert weights (mlp.experts.w13_weight) with a non-ModelOpt scale layout (.scale / .scale2 / .input_amax)
unmapped.LGAI-EXAONE/K-EXAONE-2.0-750B-A37B-NVFP4: published by LGAI-EXAONE, not NVIDIA; the backfill covers NVIDIA's own releases
unmapped.stepfun-ai/Step-3.7-Flash-NVFP4: published by stepfun-ai, not NVIDIA; the backfill covers NVIDIA's own releases. The `step3p7` architecture recipes still cover this model type
